neighbours.label: covering a thing physically: 'cover your head', 'covered with mud', 'Cover the stump'; the + pole is shutting off or excluding
fire: If there is no shelter, cover your neck with your hands.
She stood up, knees covered with dirt.
Cover the seeds with a thin layer of soil.
The soldier was covered in dust from the blast.
He dropped his bag and covered his head.
Cover the pot and let it simmer.
Their boots were covered with thick mud.
Snow had covered the whole car by morning.
quiet: If there is no shelter, run to the nearest town.
She stood up, knees shaking from fear.
Plant the seeds in a row near the fence.
The soldier was tired from the long march.
He dropped his bag and opened the door.
Stir the pot and let it boil.
Their boots were next to the front door.
Snow had closed the whole road by morning.
